content:
lee: Noticed a burst of reconnects from a few EU tenants around 09:42 while debugging a different alert. Seems correlated with ws half-close followed by immediate client reconnects.
nina: Half-close as in TCP FIN from proxy? or app-level close?
lee: Proxy sends a half-close when it sees idle timeout, clients interpret as terminal and re-open. Problem is keepalive jitter is sometimes > lease ttl so session gets tombstoned before reconnect completes.
pat: Do we have logs?
lee: snippet from proxy logs:
```
[09:42:11] ws: conn=tx-9a3 client_ip=1.2.3.4 event=half_close idle_ms=30000
[09:42:11] lease: session_id=sess-8b reason=ttl_expired ttl_ms=30000
[09:42:11] client: reconnect start conn_new=tx-9a4
[09:42:12] metering: tokens=1.0 tag=unknown
```
pat: And console sampling? IIRC our ws sampling for reconnect events is 0.5% globally.
console-team: Correct. That's to keep ingestion costs low, but it's rough when small groups spike. We only saw a tiny blip in the dashboard.
nina: billing-svc: We're seeing ~2x token accounting for those tenants because reconnect flows hit the metering pipeline twice: once on initial session and once on new connection before tombstone dedupe runs.
billing-svc: This is because reconnects are currently metered per-connection and dedupe window is 60s. If session tombstone happens before dedupe, tokens get double-counted.
lee: So root cause chain: keepalive jitter > lease_ttl -> proxy half-close -> client reconnects -> session tombstone -> metering sees two separate connections -> double billing.
pat: Proposed mitigations?
nina: Short-term: increase console sampling to 5% for eu-west for 30 minutes so ops can see the pattern. Also temporarily raise dedupe window to 90s for the affected tenants.
pat: Medium-term: add a small "post-halfclose_hold_ms" that tells proxy to wait ~150ms before tombstoning session if a reconnect is observed from same client IP or token. This would reduce race where client reconnects immediately.
lee: I suggest a config flag and rollout plan. Example config:
```
ws:
  idle_timeout_ms: 30000
  keepalive_jitter_cap_ms: 100
  post_halfclose_hold_ms: 150
metering:
  session_dedupe_window_ms: 60000  # default
  add_reconnect_tag: true
```
pat: Also add explicit metering tag on reconnect path: "reconnect=true" so billing pipeline can apply forgiveness rules (no token charge for reconnect within dedupe window).
billing-svc: We can implement tag-aware logic but need a schema change in the metering proto. Backwards-compatible: if tag absent, keep existing semantics.
console-team: UX: when ops flips sampling up we should automatically enable a short-term ingest retention for the affected timeslice so traces for those reconnections don't get discarded by downstream.
nina: Rollout plan: feature flag ws_halfclose_hold_v1. Start at 0.1% -> 1% -> 10% -> 100%. During canary bump console sampling and set a temporary dedupe_window_ms=90000. Monitor metrics: ws.half_close.count, ws.reconnect.count, metering.duplicate_tokens.count, p95_conn_latency.
lee: Tests: unit for post_halfclose_hold when reconnect arrives within hold window; integration test with local client simulating jittered keepalives.
pat: Action items:
- ninA: deploy console sampling change + alert (PR)
- lee: implement post_halfclose_hold flag in proxy (PR)
- billing-svc: proto change + dedupe logic (RFC + PR)
- pat: add canary playbook entries and guardrails (timeouts/rollback)
ops-bot: Scheduled deploy: proxy:feature/halfclose-hold -> staging at 13:05. CI green.
ops-bot: Canary flag ws_halfclose_hold_v1=0.1% scheduled at 13:20. Watchlist dashboard https://console.redwood/d/ops/ws-halfclose-debug
console-team: Added temporary alert: if metering.duplicate_tokens.count > 5/min AND ws.reconnect.count > 10/min -> paging.
lee: One more caveat: some SDKs aggressively reconnect on half-close; if we add hold, clients might see slightly longer reconnection time (~150ms) but avoid double billing. Need to update client SDK docs.
nina: Agree. Add note to client changelog and suggest exponential backoff jitter as permanent fix.
pat: OK let's move forward. Re-check after 30m of canary. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
